Management Discussion

EX13-MDA-MARKER Revenue for the year was 62.8 billion dollars, up 4 percent. Software revenue grew 9 percent, led by hybrid cloud subscriptions, while infrastructure revenue fell as clients waited for a new product cycle. The company expects mid-single-digit revenue growth next year.

Gross profit margin expanded by 1.2 points to 57.3 percent, driven by a higher share of software in the revenue mix and by productivity programs. Free cash flow was 12.1 billion dollars, which the company used for dividends, acquisitions and debt reduction.
